description: This PHP source file defines the CacheService class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides static methods to access cache instances, specifically utilizing the FilesystemAdapter for caching purposes, and manages these cache instances in a static array for reuse.

classes.name: CacheService
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve cache instances by namespace, utilizing FilesystemAdapter, and manages cache instances in a static array.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns a cache instance associated with the specified namespace, creating a new FilesystemAdapter if it doesn't already exist in the static cache array.
